subject: Edge OpenTelemetry adapter — compatibility, certification, and go-to-market sprint
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@datadog.com>, Samir Patel <samir@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Edge OpenTelemetry adapter — compatibility, certification, and go-to-market sprint

Hi Elena + Samir,

Thanks again for the quick sync at KubeCon — wanted to pull together a short plan so our teams can move into a focused sprint next week. The ask from both sides was straightforward: certify Redwood's Edge OTEL adapter for Datadog and Grafana ingestion paths, and align commercial packaging so we can list a joint integration in marketplaces + run a co-marketing webinar in Q3.

Key pieces we propose kicking off this week:
- Compatibility matrix (logs/traces/metrics + OTLP, OTLP/HTTP, and collector config variants) — attached (edge-otel-compat-matrix.xlsx).
- Certification checklist (acceptance criteria, test harness, runtime versions).
- Commercial SOW draft for joint listing & support commitments — attached draft-sow-redwood-ddog-grafana.pdf.
- GTM milestones: marketplace cert, partner listing, webinar, joint PR.

Action items for this thread:
1) Elena/Samir: confirm the specific ingestion endpoints/agent versions we should test against (Datadog Agent 7.x vs 8.x, Grafana Agent 0.26+ etc).
2) Ben/Laura (Redwood): share an initial test plan and proposed SLA for certified integrations by EOD tomorrow.
3) Everyone: Availability for a 60-min technical triage on Monday 26 July (proposed 10:00 PT).

I'll own the certification matrix updates and the SOW iteration. Ben will pick up pricing/packaging. Laura will own GTM comms and marketplace intake.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Integrations, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: edge-otel-compat-matrix.xlsx, draft-sow-redwood-ddog-grafana.pdf
From: Elena Morris <emorris@datadog.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge OpenTelemetry adapter — compatibility, certification, and go-to-market sprint

Thanks Connor — this looks good. Quick notes from the Datadog side after a fast review of the matrix:
- Primary targets: Datadog Agent 8.x (OTLP ingest) and Datadog Trace Agent for legacy trace formats.
- We'll need a containerized test harness that exercises metric aggregation (histograms), delta counters, and trace sampling headers. Could your team provide a small traffic generator image?
- Security: for any marketplace listing we require an audit of TLS cert handling and a diagram of data flow for managed vs private deployments.

I can commit two engineers to the Monday triage (10:00 PT) and we'll provide a short list of test VMs for a week-long run.

Elena Morris
Integration Lead, Datadog
emorris@datadog.com

On the commercial side, can Ben share proposed support SLA tiers and recommended pricing bands so we can validate marketplace fee splits and co-sell incentives?
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@datadog.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@grafana.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge OpenTelemetry adapter — compatibility, certification, and go-to-market sprint

Elena — appreciate the ask. Quick commercial / ops reply:
- Proposed pricing bands (for marketplace listing):
  * Basic (no SLA, community support): $0/mo listing, usage-based telemetry ingestion fees as per Redwood hosted pricing.
  * Standard (email support, 72h response): $500/mo listing fee + shared referral credit.
  * Enterprise (SLA, 24h support, dedicated engineering onboarding): $3k/mo listing fee + negotiated revenue share.
- We'll include a Support Addendum in the SOW that maps to Datadog/Grafana marketplace expectations.
- For the test harness: yes, we can provide a traffic generator docker image and a small Kubernetes manifest to run the collector + traffic generator. I'll attach a first cut of the SOW after I add the SLA appendix.

Next steps for the thread:
- Connor/Laura: compile the acceptance criteria and test plan items.
- Elena/Samir: send the exact agent version matrix and any sandbox endpoints.
- All: confirm Monday 10:00 PT triage (Zoom link attached in related_links).

Ben Carter
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: mgmt-summary-gomarket.odt
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@datadog.com>, Samir Patel <samir@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge OpenTelemetry adapter — compatibility, certification, and go-to-market sprint

Thanks for the quick triage today — summary + owners below. (Meeting recording: https://zoom.us/rec/meeting-abc-20270726)

Summary:
- Technical: Redwood will run the compatibility matrix against Datadog Agent 8.1 and Grafana Agent 0.28. Test harness (docker image + k8s manifest) will be provided by Redwood by EOD Thursday 29 Jul. Datadog will provide sandbox ingest endpoints and Grafana will provide example agent config snippets for batching/sampling.
- Security: Redwood to deliver a data-flow diagram, TLS cert handling doc, and a short checklist for private deployment options (VPC). Elena requested these by Tue 3 Aug.
- Commercial: Ben to circulate an SOW v1 with SLA appendix and pricing bands; target SOW sign-off for pilot by 2027-08-15. Deal/marketplace intake HS ticket HS-12984 created for tracking.
- GTM: Laura to draft webinar outline and landing page copy; target live webinar in the first half of September.

Owners & deadlines:
- Connor: compat matrix updates + test harness (due 2027-07-29).
- Ben: SOW v1 + pricing appendix (due 2027-08-02).
- Laura: GTM assets (outline + landing page copy) (due 2027-08-12).
- Elena/Samir: sandbox endpoints, agent versions & config snippets (due 2027-07-30).

Please reply-all if any of the dates look infeasible. I'll convert this summary into a one-page mutual action plan and drop it in the Drive folder.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Integrations, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced during meeting: edge-otel-compat-matrix.xlsx, draft-sow-redwood-ddog-grafana.pdf
